title: Apex track layout
description: One layout of one race track: timing lines, corners and the driven line. Mirrors the Track model of the Apex app (formatVersion 1).

example.description: Synthetic sample for docs and tests. Allowed only under tracks/_example/, never in the index.

id.description: Stable UUID of the layout. Never changes once merged; the app matches its own copy of the track by it.

slug.description: Latin kebab-case, equal to the file name without .json. Layouts of one place share a prefix: igora-drive, igora-drive-short.

name.description: Official name in Latin script, layout included: "Igora Drive — Full".

localName.description: Name in the local language and script (e.g. Cyrillic for a Russian track).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case; the directory is the same code in lower case.

center.description: Middle of the track, used to find tracks near the driver.

startFinish.description: Start line; also the finish on a circuit.

finish.description: Separate finish line (point-to-point: hill climb, sprint). Absent — a circuit, laps end at the start line.

sectors.description: Sector split lines in lap order (start/finish excluded).

corners.description: Corners in lap order, numbered as on the official map when there is one.

outline.description: The driven line of one clean lap, in the direction of travel. A circuit closes on itself.

lengthM.description: Lap (or run) length along the outline, metres.

direction.description: Circuits: clockwise or counter-clockwise seen from above.

variantOf.description: Slug of the main layout of the same place, when this is another layout of it.

source.description: Where the lines, corners and outline come from.

outlineSource.description: Only when the outline comes from elsewhere than the rest (e.g. OpenStreetMap).

license.description: MIT for own work; ODbL-1.0 when anything in the file is derived from OpenStreetMap.

author.description: GitHub handle of who marked the track.

contributors.description: GitHub handles of who corrected it later.

raceChronoID.description: The track's number in RaceChrono's online library, as a cross-reference only (no data from it).

updated.description: Date of the last change of the markup, YYYY-MM-DD.

geoPoint.description: WGS 84, decimal degrees, at least 6 decimals.

gate.description: A timing line: its middle, the direction of travel across it and its full width.

heading.description: Compass bearing of travel, degrees: 0 north, 90 east.

details.description: What exactly: receiver and date of the lap, way ids, how it was checked.
